pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 你好 (nǐ hǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To be called
   B. I, me
   C. Hello
   D. Classmates

2. Why is it good to retell what you heard in your own words? (1 mark)
   A. It makes you forget
   B. It is only for teachers
   C. It shows you understood the key points
   D. It is a way to play

3. What does 客厅里有电视 mean? (1 mark)
   A. The living room is on the television
   B. The television is in the kitchen
   C. I like television
   D. There is a television in the living room

4. What does 床 (chuáng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bed
   B. House
   C. Kitchen
   D. Cat

5. Which word is pronounced xǐhuan? (1 mark)
   A. 饼干
   B. 喜欢
   C. 苹果
   D. 吃

6. Which word is pronounced xiāngjiāo? (1 mark)
   A. 牛奶
   B. 蔬菜
   C. 米饭
   D. 香蕉

7. Which Chinese word means "where"? (1 mark)
   A. 卧室 wòshì
   B. 门 mén
   C. 旁边 pángbiān
   D. 哪儿 nǎr

8. What does 桌子 (zhuōzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Table
   B. Things
   C. Below
   D. House

9. What does 厕所 (cèsuǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Garden
   B. Left side
   C. Toilet
   D. Is at, is in

10. Which word is pronounced tóngxuémen? (1 mark)
   A. 早上好
   B. 再见
   C. 叫
   D. 同学们

11. What does 是 (shì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Love
   B. Daughter
   C. Older sister
   D. Is, am, are

12. What does 洗手 (xǐshǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tooth
   B. Ear
   C. To wash hands
   D. Two (before a counting word)

13. In 我的生日是三月五号, on which date is the birthday? (1 mark)
   A. 3 May
   B. 5 May
   C. 5 March
   D. 3 March

14. Read the pinyin: zhè shì tàiyáng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The rain is heavy.
   B. Today there are clouds.
   C. The wind is very strong.
   D. This is the sun.

15. Which word means "snacks"? (1 mark)
   A. 饮料
   B. 零食
   C. 蔬菜
   D. 水果

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. A picture shows a girl but the label says 儿子. Is the pair 对 or 错? Explain. (2 marks)

17. Describe how to work out the meaning of an unknown word in a sentence. (3 marks)

18. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 小 and 哥哥. (2 marks)

19. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期二 and 晚饭. (2 marks)

20. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 香蕉 and 饼. (2 marks)

21. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 祝 and 电视. (2 marks)

22. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ xǐhuan hē chá. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Hello
   你好 (nǐ hǎo) means hello.

2. C — It shows you understood the key points
   Retelling keeps the main ideas and shows understanding.

3. D — There is a television in the living room
   里 is inside and 有 is there is.

4. A — Bed
   床 (chuáng) means bed.

5. B — 喜欢
   喜欢 is pronounced xǐhuan and means to like.

6. D — 香蕉
   香蕉 is pronounced xiāngjiāo and means banana.

7. D — 哪儿 nǎr
   哪儿 (nǎr) means where.

8. A — Table
   桌子 (zhuōzi) means table.

9. C — Toilet
   厕所 (cèsuǒ) means toilet.

10. D — 同学们
   同学们 is pronounced tóngxuémen and means classmates.

11. D — Is, am, are
   是 (shì) means is, am, are.

12. C — To wash hands
   洗手 (xǐshǒu) means to wash hands.

13. C — 5 March
   三月 is March and 五号 is the fifth.

14. D — This is the sun.
   zhè shì tàiyáng. is 这是太阳。, which means "This is the sun.".

15. B — 零食
   零食 língshí is snacks.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: 错 (wrong). 儿子 means son, but the picture shows a girl.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying 错 and 1 mark for the reason.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Read the whole sentence, look at the words you know, look at pictures, then guess and check with a friend or dictionary.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three steps.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: 小: xiǎo, small. 哥哥: gēge, older brother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: 星期二: xīngqī'èr, Tuesday. 晚饭: wǎnfàn, dinner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: 香蕉: xiāngjiāo, banana. 饼: bǐng, flat bread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: 祝: zhù, to wish. 电视: diànshì, television.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like to drink tea.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.
